data.gender_notes: Lujaina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'L-J-N' which means 'to rest' or 'to be safe'. Lujaina is a name of grace and beauty in Islam. It is mentioned in the Quran as a name of one of the wives of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) (Quran 12:23). The name Lujaina carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Lujaina usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lujaina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
